data.name: GF6E_001
data.value: The forest begins beyond these old ruins.

data.name: GF6E_002
data.value: Chenipent loves hiding under leaves... I hope he is not frightened.

data.name: GF6E_003
data.value: We will find him. Stay close, and do not lose sight of us.

data.name: GF6E_004
data.value: That path is darker than it looked from the village.

data.name: GF6E_005
data.value: Let’s go. Someone is waiting for us inside.

data.name: GF6E_006
data.value: Thank you. I will wait here until you bring him back.

data.name: GF6E_007
data.value: Please be careful. The forest is quiet, but it is not empty.

data.name: GF6E_008
data.value: The entrance is just ahead. I’ll wait here while you prepare.

data.name: GF6E_009
data.value: Wait... did you see that shadow move between the trees?

data.name: GF6E_010
data.value: I saw it. The forest is watching the path.

data.name: GF6E_011
data.value: Stay between us. If anything happens, we turn back together.

data.name: GF6E_012
data.value: We came to find Chenipent. We will not let the silence scare us away.

data.name: GF6E_013
data.value: The sound came from deeper inside. Chenipent may have followed it.

data.name: GF6E_014
data.value: Please do not rush. The forest changes when no one is looking.

data.name: GF6E_015
data.value: Then we take one step at a time and keep our formation.

data.name: GF6E_016
data.value: Agreed. We look for tracks before we choose a path.

data.name: GF6E_017
data.value: That is why I trust you. You are careful, even when you are afraid.

data.name: GF6E_018
data.value: I will wait by these ruins. If you need me, call out.

data.name: GF6E_019
data.value: We will bring Chenipent back before the light is gone.

data.name: GF6E_020
data.value: Thank you. Please come back safely.

data.name: GF6E_A01
data.value: The Sinister Woods...[pause=15] It certainly lives up to its name.[pause=20] Look at this fog, you can barely see the ground.

data.name: GF6E_A02
data.value: Poor Caterpie...[pause=10] Getting lost all alone in a place like this...[pause=15] I hope he's alright.

data.name: GF6E_A03
data.value: (The forest is dark, but our bond will guide us.[pause=15] We must stay focused.)

data.name: GF6E_A04
data.value: HEEEEYOOOOO !

data.name: GF6E_A05
data.value: Whoa! What was...[pause=10] Who's shouting like that?

data.name: GF6E_A06
data.value: Ugh...[pause=10] Stop screaming like that, everyone can hear you...

data.name: GF6E_A07
data.value: Hey! Move over a bit! You're blocking my view!

data.name: GF6E_A08
data.value: It's not my fault you're so slow, Sonata! Look, they're already over there!

data.name: GF6E_A09
data.value: But you don't need to run like a maniac!

data.name: GF6E_A10
data.value: Silence, both of you! Straighten your bows and stand tall.

data.name: GF6E_A11
data.value: In the end...[pause=10] we decided to accept this mission.

data.name: GF6E_A12
data.value: Turns out dear Butterfree is desperate to get her little one back![pause=15] We weren't going to let an opportunity like that slip by!

data.name: GF6E_A13
data.value: Besides, a walk in the woods is great for the skin, teehee!

data.name: GF6E_A14
data.value: Don't misunderstand, little amateurs.[pause=15] We aren't doing this for your pretty eyes.[pause=20] We're bringing Butterfree's little one back before you do, just to prove who the real elite is![pause=15] A little ego contest... and you've already lost!

data.name: GF6E_A15
data.value: What?![pause=15] But we got here first! You can't turn the rescue of Butterfree's little one into a cheap ego contest!

data.name: GF6E_A16
data.value: First come, first served, shrimp! Come on, let's go before they reach the entrance!

data.name: GF6E_A17
data.value: Don't get lost on the way, children!

data.name: GF6E_A18
data.value: Take your time.[pause=15] Amateurs need to be careful.

data.name: GF6E_A19
data.value: Did you see that?![pause=15] What arrogance! Turning the rescue of Butterfree's little one into a cheap ego contest!

data.name: GF6E_A20
data.value: (They are annoying...[pause=10] but they are ready.[pause=15] Let's go, too.)

data.name: GF6E_A21
data.value: We're not letting them get away with this, {0}![pause=15] We're going to find Caterpie before they do and show them what we're made of!

data.name: GF6E_A22
data.value: They're going in...[pause=25] The forest just swallowed them, and here we still are.

data.name: GF6E_A23
data.value: They're already inside...[pause=20] And here we are, still talking in the grass.

data.name: GF6E_A24
data.value: (Caterpie is somewhere down there.[pause=25] And now there are three other explorers between her and us.)

data.name: GF6E_A25
data.value: Then we stop talking.[pause=20] We go.
